name: Voice agent — flat documentary UI

palette.note: Override from brand-harvest ASSET_VERIFIED when available — do not invent navy/mint if site differs

layout.density: sparse — one primary action per state

motion.preferred: hold still + hard cuts between states
motion.optional: soft zoom on tap target in CapCut

prompt_template: Flat mobile UI screenshot, documentary product photography of a phone screen, NOT a 3D mockup floating in space, NOT neon, NOT glassmorphism spam. App: {{brand}} front-desk tool. Chrome: surface {{surface}} panel {{panel}} accent {{accent}}. Rounded 12px cards, 1px borders, system sans. STATE: {{state_block}}. No fake metrics. No robot avatar as the product. Hard light from screen only. 9:16; UI ≥70% frame. NEGATIVES: holographic, cyberpunk, purple glow, melted text, dashboard spaghetti
qa_hooks: no duplicate headline/caption from UI strings
